newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl repeats EMU to start on time, with Germany.
newsitem.headline: Kohl repeats EMU to start on time, with Germany.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Tuesday repeated his conviction that European monetary union (EMU) would begin on time on January 1, 1999, and that Germany would fulfil the criteria to join.
Speaking at a retirement party for the head of the German Farm Federation, Kohl rejected speculation that EMU would be delayed.
Germans should be less concerned with whether others make the grade for EMU, and concentrate on the tasks still facing them, he said.
"Just look at your own plate, and leave others' alone, and if we do so, we will reach something good with the currency union," Kohl said.
